notes:
Summary: Pinion builds a multi-tenant agent orchestration layer for ecommerce/messaging channels. Mid-market footprint, strong product-market fit among merchants. They are evaluating Redwood Hosted API first (fast time to value) with a near-term move to Dedicated reserved pools if POC meets latency/cost goals.

Key asks / constraints:
- Primary workload: real-time chat agents + outbound proactive messages; heavy use of streaming responses and tool-calling (payment/lookup connectors).
- Latency SLOs: target p50 <200ms for token generation; p95 targets 700-900ms depending on seq len. Streaming segment stability more important than absolute token p50.
- Throughput: bursts of 700 concurrent agent sessions during peak; steady-state ~120 qps across tenants.
- Multi-tenant controls: per-tenant rate limits/quota enforcement, token quota reporting per customer, and per-tenant fallback policies when burst exceeds committed capacity.
- Cost sensitivity: careful on per-tenant billing granularity; want predictable reserved capacity pricing (Dedicated) but will evaluate hosted billing to validate performance first.
- Security: require SSO/SAML for admin, audit logs surfaced to customer-facing console, optional KMS wrapped model keys, and EU data residency for a subset of customers.

POC plan (agreed):
- Week 0: onboard to Hosted API; integration of streaming SDK; run smoke tests.
- Week 1: validate latency SLOs under representative traffic (we will provide replay traces).
- Week 2: tenant-level chaos/stress test (rate-limit enforcement, tenant-level fallbacks, streaming reconnect behavior).
- Optional Week 3: Dedicated pilot quote + architecture review if hosted meets SLO/cost expectations.

Quotes & callouts:
- "Streaming must not drop tool-calls — we need guaranteed at-least-once delivery for connector invocations." — CTO (A. Moreno, 2026-02-05).
- AE notes: prefers canary on Dedicated routing by tenant tier (free, standard, premium).

Docs shared: pricing deck + technical appendix (see Drive links). Security review packet requested (they want SOC2 completion timeline).

Notes style: fragments used in call notes, sometimes shorthand. Follow-ups captured in timeline.
